project.title: R1 EBPR Enrichment Bioreactor Microbial Community
project.description: Microbial community analysis of the R1 EBPR enrichment bioreactor at the University of Wisconsin - Madison operated from 2005 to 2013. Includes raw 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing reads, raw metagenomic sequencing reads, and metagenome-assembled genomes.
